prop: ie < a.size ∧ isEven a[ie]! = true ∧ ∀ k, k < ie → isOdd a[k]! = true

children.invariant: n ≤ a.size ∧ ∀ k, k < n → isOdd a[k]! = true

children.prop: jo < a.size ∧ isOdd a[jo]! = true ∧ ∀ k, k < jo → isEven a[k]! = true

children.invariant: n ≤ a.size ∧ ∀ k, k < n → isEven a[k]! = true

lemmas.name: odd_not_even
lemmas.statement: ∀ (n : Int), isOdd n = true → ¬ isEven n = true
lemmas.proof:
by
  intro n h h2
  simp [isOdd, isEven] at h h2
  omega

lemmas.name: not_odd_even
lemmas.statement: ∀ (n : Int), ¬ isOdd n = true → isEven n = true
lemmas.proof:
by
  intro n h
  simp [isOdd, isEven] at h ⊢
  omega

lemmas.name: not_even_odd
lemmas.statement: ∀ (n : Int), ¬ isEven n = true → isOdd n = true
lemmas.proof:
by
  intro n h
  simp [isOdd, isEven] at h ⊢
  omega

lemmas.name: first_even_exit
lemmas.statement: ∀ (a : Array Int) (n : Nat), (∃ x ∈ a, isEven x = true) → (n ≤ a.size ∧ ∀ k, k < n → isOdd a[k]! = true) → ¬ (n < a.size ∧ isOdd a[n]! = true) → (n < a.size ∧ isEven a[n]! = true ∧ ∀ k, k < n → isOdd a[k]! = true)
lemmas.proof:
by
  intro a n hex ⟨hn, hall⟩ hg
  by_cases h : n < a.size
  · exact ⟨h, not_odd_even _ (fun ho => hg ⟨h, ho⟩), hall⟩
  · exfalso
    obtain ⟨k, hk, hk2⟩ := (Refine.exists_mem_array_iff_idx a (fun y => isEven y = true)).mp hex
    exact odd_not_even _ (hall k (by omega)) hk2

lemmas.name: first_odd_exit
lemmas.statement: ∀ (a : Array Int) (n : Nat), (∃ x ∈ a, isOdd x = true) → (n ≤ a.size ∧ ∀ k, k < n → isEven a[k]! = true) → ¬ (n < a.size ∧ isEven a[n]! = true) → (n < a.size ∧ isOdd a[n]! = true ∧ ∀ k, k < n → isEven a[k]! = true)
lemmas.proof:
by
  intro a n hex ⟨hn, hall⟩ hg
  by_cases h : n < a.size
  · exact ⟨h, not_even_odd _ (fun ho => hg ⟨h, ho⟩), hall⟩
  · exfalso
    obtain ⟨k, hk, hk2⟩ := (Refine.exists_mem_array_iff_idx a (fun y => isOdd y = true)).mp hex
    exact odd_not_even _ hk2 (hall k (by omega))
